descriptionChirho: A visible shape, figure, or representation of something, often in contexts of idolatry or theophanic vision (Deut 4:16-18, Ps 106:20, Isa 44:13, Ezek 8:3,10, Ezek 10:8).
An architectural design or constructional specification to be followed in building, especially the tabernacle or temple (Exod 25:9,40, 1 Chr 28:11-19).
